steps: You are invited to a family on Almari

(() => { const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="button"]')].find(e => /PAN card/.test(e.getAttribute('aria-label') || e.textContent)); if (!el) return 'MISSING PAN row'; el.click(); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const imgs = [...document.querySelectorAll('img')].filter(i => i.src.startsWith('blob:') && i.naturalWidth > 0); return imgs.length ? 'opened ' + imgs.length + ' image(s), first ' + imgs[0].naturalWidth + 'px wide' : 'EXPECTED a decrypted image'; })()
